Use warning instead of note 
https://github.com/ubiquity-os/daemon-responder
Placed under ubiquity-os because this is unlikely to be very useful for partners. More of an internal capability.
No more line review incentives is weird.

Maybe we should have a special kernel capability to import from another config to keep everything in sync. 
Inspired by css @import style.css syntax 
Is there anything in the yml spec for this? Imagine a config file that is just an import.
Sorry my client was out of date.

@whilefoo any ideas regarding importing another yaml given your knowledge of the kernel?
I think we could really benefit from it cause I think we have six configs floating around now.

Docker include syntax is nice and then we can add another `text-conversation-rewards` config at the end as an override to fix the encrypted key problem. 
But docker include syntax is for multiple yaml files and I anticipate we will only need to import one for this problem we are trying to solve. 
They aren't mutually exclusive, especially if we do the override strategy then the tool can still help with editing the overrides.

When any comments are posted, automatically reply with a configurable message. I think the default can be something instructional like "You must set the default auto response in the configuration."
The intended use case is to guide users who mistakenly try and self assign directly on the directory:
Originally posted by @Keyrxng https://github.com/ubiquity/devpool-directory-bounties/issues/36
You should have some default as per the spec
